command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes'); foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$name=`$n.name; `$cs=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$name+'/commands'); `$key=(`$cs.commands | Where-Object { `$_.command_key -match '^(display_current-configuration|show_running-config)$' } | Select-Object -First 1).command_key; if (`$key) { `$u5='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$name+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$key); `$u6='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$name+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$key); try { `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u5).output -split '\r?\n'; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u6).output -split '\r?\n'; `$d=Compare-Object `$a `$b | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -notmatch '^(Info:|Time:|!Time:|#|return|$)' }; if (`$d) { '===== '+`$name+' ====='; `$d | ForEach-Object { `$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject } } } catch {} } }"
